svg.aria-label: Sledge analytics pipeline: events are validated and loaded into SQL Server, a founder dashboard reads the sensitive warehouse, and only five categorical, hashed fields cross the GA4 boundary through a separate low-privilege exporter.
svg.text: How a made-up construction app event becomes a founder dashboard number, and a GA4-safe event
reads action, module, surface, channel, tenant_id
never reads amounts, names, tax IDs or times
Four independent checks. Any one stops a leak.
builds a new object from 5 named fields;
every value must be a known code;
tenant ID is HMAC-SHA256, key stays in
The outbox cannot hold a leak
own login, SELECT on 7 safe columns,
no access to raw, core or analytics
it is written · 12 tests guard all four
Sample data · SQL Server 2022 · Python 3 · pyodbc · see README.md for the data model
